description: Node's keylog event on slicc-kernel 1.154's keylog: a tls.connect socket's and a tls.Server's lines (with the socket), an https.Agent's and an https.Server's, and both ends of TLS over a socket: the four TLS 1.3 traffic secret lines in NSS key log format before secureConnect, one client random and the same secrets on both sides (Node's EXPORTER_SECRET line, which the kernel's engine doesn't log, is left out)
